scenarios.name: normal_operation
scenarios.description: 正常 Traffic Manager 操作场景：创建配置文件 → 添加终结点 → 列出终结点 → 查询配置文件 → 删除
commands: az network traffic-manager profile create --name test-tm-profile --resource-group test-rg --routing-method Performance
az network traffic-manager endpoint create --name test-endpoint --profile-name test-tm-profile --resource-group test-rg --type ExternalEndpoints --target target1.example.com
az network traffic-manager endpoint list --profile-name test-tm-profile --resource-group test-rg
az network traffic-manager profile show --name test-tm-profile --resource-group test-rg
az network traffic-manager profile delete --name test-tm-profile --resource-group test-rg --yes

scenarios.name: partial_failure
scenarios.description: 部分失败场景：配置文件创建成功但终结点创建失败
commands: az network traffic-manager profile create --name fail-tm-profile --resource-group test-rg --routing-method Performance
az network traffic-manager endpoint create --name fail-endpoint --profile-name fail-tm-profile --resource-group test-rg --type ExternalEndpoints --target target1.example.com

scenarios.name: full_failure
scenarios.description: 完全失败场景：配置文件不存在
commands: az network traffic-manager profile show --name nonexistent-tm-profile --resource-group test-rg
